subject: CAMPAIGN GOAL: the sentiment pipeline tells the truth on every surface it draws, in the order this card holds
activeForm: Working the board in priority order
description:
THE GOAL. Every surface this service draws is currently lying in a different way: the chart pins near +1.0 because fanout discards sign, its source selector renders one identical line in four modes, the frontend keeps the previous series when a mode returns empty, and the digest labels every ticker neutral because its queries throw. Above them sits a deploy gate that cannot fail and a Dependabot backlog a pre-push check reported as zero until card #10 made it read every page (card #15 fixed 27 of its 28; one waits on upstream). Work the cards until each surface shows measured data or an honest empty state, and until a broken deploy or an open alert is stopped by a gate rather than by a reader noticing.

UPDATE DISCIPLINE. New scope is appended here as discovered; finished items are deleted, not annotated. Cards are canon for their own content; this list is canon for ordering. On main, update this file in the same commit that adds, trims or deletes a card. On a card branch it is not yours to write: report the board change you need in your final message and Helios makes it.

THE LIFECYCLE IS HYDROSTAT. Canon is ~/dotfiles/docs/hydrostat.md and it is not copied here. The machine is installed once on this host as `hydrostat` and `card-start` on PATH and serves every repository; .hydrostat.json at this root tunes it. `hydrostat <id>` is the one button and `hydrostat <id> --query` looks without stepping.

READY TO RUN NOW, nothing blocking them in the graph: 1, 7, 11, 18 to 20, 22 to 27. Card #15 waits on an upstream release. Card #1 waits on the operator's bootstrap apply, #7 on the alarms decision and #14 on two operator calls, so #22 runs next.

OPERATOR ACTIONS OWED, named by card #8's attestation and fixable nowhere in this repo. TIINGO_API_KEY and FINNHUB_API_KEY do not exist; until they are created the 22 @external-api tests run in zero CI contexts and nightly-e2e reports green having run nothing. SECURITY.md is public and card #8 rewrote it; its 48-hour acknowledgement promise stands until the operator confirms or withdraws it. No deploy watching is owed: the 16 sanity tests have never executed against preprod, so a red test-preprod is most likely the gate reporting something always true, and AGENTS.md's gotcha says to diagnose before reverting the gate.

PRIORITY ORDER.
1. Card #1 (signed-fanout). Implemented on branch 001-signed-fanout, PR #1032 open with checks green. Remaining: merge, the admin bootstrap apply for the backfill IAM role, and the data backfill on separate per-environment operator go. Unblocks 2, 4, 5 and 6, which is most of the board.
2. Card #22 (check-branch-collision refuses every push from a card worktree, reading the checked-out branch and finding Hydrostat's own claim ref). Every Dynamo that needs a CI branch pays for it.
3. Card #27 (preprod's sign-in page shows no OAuth buttons; auth.spec.ts:24 fails on every deploy, cause unmeasured). The customer-facing lie with no card until now; the fix may turn out to be operator configuration rather than code.
4. Card #18 (pip-audit reports 207 findings in 27 packages while Dependabot shows 0 open pip alerts; cause unmeasured, the first fact being that pip-audit audits the venv rather than the manifests). Decides which of the two security views is lying.
5. Card #23 (Dependency Vulnerability Scan red on every main push since three pip-audit ignores expired 2026-09-30). Decide it WITH card #18, which asks why pip-audit and Dependabot disagree.
6. Card #24 (Pre-commit Hooks job red on main because detect-secrets flags the landing sha in every cards/closed/*.json). The archive format comes from Hydrostat, so the fix may belong in dotfiles.
7. Card #20 (36 time.time() calls left in src/ outside the caches, raised by card #16: some measure elapsed time, such as SSE heartbeats, failover durations and the CloudWatch flush timer, and some are real epochs). Nothing has failed from them. Its runConfiguration needs the operator's three answers.
8. Card #25 (the alert form wipes user input on every parent re-render). Customer-facing; unmeasured in a browser.
9. Card #26 (session-expiry messages are never shown: written to the memory-only auth store, then the page reloads). Customer-facing; unmeasured in a browser.
10. Card #2 (source attribution always 'dedup:'). Kills the chart's source modes at the root.
11. Card #3 (chart keeps a stale series). Small fix, but decide it WITH card #2: once real sources flow, empty modes get rarer and silence is still a lie.
12. Card #4 (digest never worked). Check whether digest emails currently ship to anyone before spending on it.
13. Card #5 (finance-native model swap). Research is DONE, no re-derivation owed.
14. Card #6 (live README hero). Commissioned as a battleplan with a research component. The static hero it succeeds is already shipped and in README.md:7.
15. Card #19 (Tailwind 4 migration, the only route past GHSA-rj75-hqrm-r3gf in postcss-selector-parser; medium severity, a real migration across the frontend's styling). Also removes one of #226's two braces paths.
16. Card #11 (QUARRYSOME closeout). One audit from v1-done. Stays open by standing operator decision until its work items land.
17. Card #9 (specs tree hygiene). Blocked by 1 and 11 on purpose: its sweep adjudicates the specs/ dirs those cards still occupy, so it runs last among them. Note for its sweep: specs/001-prepush-alert-visibility/ (untracked) is superseded by specs/1402-prepush-alert-visibility/ except its section 'Adjacent Defects Observed, Carded Not Fixed', whose four items exist nowhere else; adjudicate them before the dir goes.
18. Card #14 (two offline drift checks as BLOCKING validate stages: check-injected-docs from card #8, check-alert-query-copies from card #10). Blocked on two separate operator yes-or-no calls; both raising cards recommend yes, each with 0 false positives measured. A no closes that work item.
19. Card #15 (Dependabot backlog). 27 of 28 alerts fixed at landing 175fab87; #226 (braces <= 3.0.3, high) remains and waits on an upstream braces release or @next/eslint-plugin-next dropping its fast-glob 3.3.1 pin. Not runnable until one exists; cards/15.json states the check. The operator's call on making make check-security-alerts gating now faces this one alert with no fix route rather than 28.
20. Card #7 (re-add CloudWatch alarms). Blocked on the operator deciding alarms are wanted again. The deletion was a cost call, not a verdict.

PUSH SAFETY, from card #21 (landing 1842fa7e). A pre-push from a linked worktree runs that worktree's own tests/unit/conftest.py, so a card branch cut before 1842fa7e still flips the shared repo to core.bare=true when it pushes. Push from a card worktree only once its branch contains 1842fa7e; hydrostat's landing pushes run from the root checkout and are always safe.

STANDING, NOT ORDERED. cards/improve-local.json is this repo's improve-local inbox: a dump target, never a queue position. File with `improve-drop.sh local` and batch with `improve-collect.py local` from this root checkout.

SPEC DIRS WITH NO CARD, MEASURED SHIPPED 2026-09-22. Each was checked against the tree rather than against its own status line, which still says Draft in several cases. They need no card and card #9's sweep disposes of the dirs: 001-makefile-hardening (terraform 1.9.8 pinned in .terraform-version, check-iam-patterns BLOCKING at Makefile:89, cost-check and infracost targets live), 001-makefile-compose-repair (COMPOSE = docker compose at Makefile:236 with the loud preflight at 248-251), 001-secrets-wrapper-normalize (volatile-vs-substantive logic live in scripts/detect-secrets-autostage.sh:9-10,45,49,78-91), 001-eslint-9-flat-config (eslint ^9 and frontend/eslint.config.mjs, no .eslintrc, next ^16.2.12), 001-readme-landing (hero at README.md:7), 001-md-overhaul (phase-6 closeout PASS; SC-004 re-measured 14,337 against its 35,055 ceiling), 001-makefile-stale-shortlist (input document to 001-md-overhaul).


CROSS-BOARD, no action owed. scottgoscott's cards/3.json targets this repo for a portfolio pass (three chaos scenarios and a README pass, its specs/0007). It is not running and not scheduled, and its own card records that it cannot sensibly run while this board's surfaces are still being corrected. If this board reaches its goal and the pass is wanted, say so through the board inbox and scottgoscott's Helios sequences it.

OTHER OPEN LOOSE ENDS. PR #1035 (remove cloudwatch alarms) and PR #866 (fix 2 vacuous E2E tests, open since 2026-04-05) are both open and unmerged; decide merge or close.
